preamble: All clues are normal. At ten intersections (squares at which across and down words meet or cross each other) it will be found that the relevant letters of the two words do not tally. In each case solvers should enter the letter midway between the non-matching letters alphabetically (treating the alphabet as cyclical), the two words affected becoming nonwords. The letters entered may be one, two or three letters away from the non-matching letters in each case, e.g. X might represent W/Y, V/Z or U/A. The ten letters thus entered, read row by row from left to right and top to bottom of the diagram, form a two-word proper name appropriate to the title of the puzzle. No across or down word in the diagram is affected more than once, and the replaced letters may occur in either order.
